title: Notification dialog focus containment and scroll isolation

behavior.focusContainment: Tab and Shift+Tab wrap between the first and last usable controls inside the open tenant-bound notification dialog; focus moved outside the dialog is recovered at the next tab boundary.
behavior.scrollIsolation: The notification popover and its scrollable feed contain overscroll so keyboard or touch scrolling does not move the workspace behind the dialog.
behavior.preserved: Focus-on-open, Escape dismissal, bell focus restoration, filtering, pagination, unread summary, read/unread actions, preference saves, SSE reconnect, polling fallback and tenant-safe deep links remain unchanged.

localVerification.uiHarness: verify-local --ui-only --ui-spec=notifications.spec.ts failed closed before fixture startup because 127.0.0.1:6379 was occupied; no existing service was contacted.

focusedBrowserRegression.coverage: tenant feed/pagination/read state, SSE reconnect and tenant-safe deep link
focusedBrowserRegression.mediaFixturesSkipped: The focused notification UI suite creates its own database records and does not use generated media files; the Windows ffmpeg/fontconfig prerequisite is therefore outside this focused run.
focusedBrowserRegression.existingRedis: 127.0.0.1:6379 was left running and was never contacted; the owned Redis fixture used 6380 and was cleaned up.
focusedBrowserRegression.browser: Existing Windows Google Chrome executable via CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH

localVerification.verificationTooling: scripts/verify-local.mjs now accepts --redis-port=<1024-65535> and preserves CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH when supplied; defaults and CI behavior remain unchanged.

package.hashAndByteReceipt: Recorded in the external final receipt; source package is regenerated from this closure tree.

limits: This increment changes only notification dialog keyboard focus and scroll containment plus browser regression coverage.
CI verifies owned fixtures and does not deploy.
Production/live-provider, external delivery, remote durability/RPO-RTO, deployed and full-master acceptance remain open.
